correctness.rationale: All n>=6: signed fixed-face lemma reconstructs the reduced chain Lefschetz character with proper simplex orientation and empty face. Rotation orbit graphs are C_d^2 for d>=3, otherwise empty. Odd reflections yield a path square with one pendant, even reflections yield path squares with zero or two pendants. Exact independent polynomial recurrences follow from the explicit 3x3 transfer matrix and endpoint conditioning. Barycentric subdivision rational invariants prove the quotient formula; characteristic-root dominance proves unboundedness. Standalone all-element verification n=6..22 and quotient integrality n=6..500 passed; finite evidence only corroborates.

originality.rationale: Examined actual results and proofs from the early cycle-power independence-complex classification and the later reduced-Euler study of circulants, and compared explicit statement implications against relevant published cycle dihedral records. The existing homotopy and ordinary Euler statements do not imply the present action-sensitive topological quotient formula. No stronger covering result was found in the searches. Unindexed equivalent derivations remain a residual risk.

value.rationale: Computes the complete virtual dihedral homology character and ordinary topological quotient reduced Euler characteristic of a historically central infinite sequence of independence complexes. The action-sensitive invariant is not determined by published ordinary homotopy types. The resulting unboundedness theorem forces infinitely many non-acyclic rational symmetry quotients, a substantive structural consequence with no arbitrary finite cutoff.
